tags.name: LotteryService
tags.description:
LotteryService is the contract between the Java BFF and the Go
lottery-stats-server. The Go service owns the tree-based analysis engine
(internal/lottery-tree) and the lottery_results store. It is stateless
beyond the historical draws table: no user data, no saved forms.

post.summary: Analyze evaluates user-selected numbers against historical winning draws.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: AnalyzeRequest mirrors the original FormAnalyzeCalculations model.

post.summary:
GenerateForm generates lottery number combinations based on
historical-draw patterns over an optional date window.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: GenerateFormRequest mirrors the original FormCalculations model.

post.summary: GetStatistics calculates frequent number pairs/groups over a date window.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: GetStatisticsRequest mirrors the original statsCalculations model.

post.summary:
Simulate backtests a user's numbers against historical draws over a date
window, computing ticket cost spent and prizes won per draw and in total.
Supports systematic forms (6, 8, 10, 12 numbers) where all C(N,6)
combinations are played per draw.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description:
SimulateRequest backtests a user's form against historical draws.
The form may contain 6, 8, 10, or 12 numbers (systematic forms).
For N > 6, all C(N,6) combinations are played per draw.

Two date windows are supported:
  - archive_window: the historical-draw range used as context (the
    archive that is loaded). Unset = full archive.
  - simulate_window: the sub-range of draws to actually backtest the
    user's numbers against. If unset, falls back to archive_window
    (preserving the legacy single-window behavior).
This enables a train/test split: study patterns over archive_window,
then backtest the chosen numbers over simulate_window.

get.summary: HealthCheck returns the health status of the service.

form.description: The user's selected numbers to evaluate.

v1AnalyzeRequest.description: AnalyzeRequest mirrors the original FormAnalyzeCalculations model.

frequency_groups.description:
Grouped frequency results, one entry per group size (1–6).
Each group contains the number combinations of that size and their
occurrence counts, mirroring the legacy 2D-array analyze output.

archive_size.description: Number of historical draws used for the analysis (archive size).

v1AnalyzeResponse.description: AnalyzeResponse is the analysis of the user's form against history.

v1DateWindow.description:
DateWindow is an optional historical-draw window. If both bounds are unset
the service uses the full archive.

numbers.description: The numbers in this combination (length = group size).

count.description: How many times this combination appeared in the archive.

v1FrequencyEntry.description: FrequencyEntry is one number combination and its occurrence count.

size.description: Group size: 1 = single number, 2 = pair, 3 = triple, etc.

combos.description: Total possible combinations for this group size (C(37, size)).

entries.description: Frequency entries in this group, sorted by count descending.

v1FrequencyGroup.description: FrequencyGroup holds all frequency entries for a specific group size.

will_be.description: Numbers the user wants included in every generated form ("willBe").

window.description: Optional historical window. Unset = full archive.

v1GenerateFormRequest.description: GenerateFormRequest mirrors the original FormCalculations model.

v1GenerateFormResponse.description: GenerateFormResponse is a list of generated combinations.

v1GetStatisticsRequest.description: GetStatisticsRequest mirrors the original statsCalculations model.

v1GetStatisticsResponse.description: GetStatisticsResponse is the list of frequent pairs/groups.

v1HealthCheckResponse.description: HealthCheckResponse contains the health status of the service.

v1NumberSet.description: NumberSet is one generated combination (regular numbers + optional strong).

v1Pair.description: Pair is a frequent number group with its occurrence count.

tier_hits.description: Prize tiers hit in this draw (may be multiple for systematic forms).

prize_won.description: Total prize won in this draw (ILS).

used_real_prizes.description:
True when the prize amounts used for this draw came from the scraped
per-draw prize data (lottery_results.prize_amounts). False when the
service fell back to default estimates or user-supplied overrides.

v1SimulateDrawResult.description: SimulateDrawResult is the simulation result for a single historical draw.

form.description: The user's selected numbers (6, 8, 10, or 12 for systematic forms).

strong.description: The user's strong number (1-7). 0 = no strong number.

archive_window.description:
The archive window (historical context). Unset = full archive.
Renamed from "window" (field number unchanged → wire-compatible).

ticket_cost.description: Ticket cost per table/combination in ILS. Default 3.0.

prize_amounts.description:
User-configurable prize amounts per tier (ILS). If empty, service
defaults are used. Index 0 = tier 1 (6+strong), ..., 7 = tier 8 (3).
Must be length 0 or 8.

simulate_window.description:
The backtest window — draws to actually simulate against. If unset,
falls back to archive_window (legacy single-window behavior).

v1SimulateRequest.description:
SimulateRequest backtests a user's form against historical draws.
The form may contain 6, 8, 10, or 12 numbers (systematic forms).
For N > 6, all C(N,6) combinations are played per draw.

Two date windows are supported:
  - archive_window: the historical-draw range used as context (the
    archive that is loaded). Unset = full archive.
  - simulate_window: the sub-range of draws to actually backtest the
    user's numbers against. If unset, falls back to archive_window
    (preserving the legacy single-window behavior).
This enables a train/test split: study patterns over archive_window,
then backtest the chosen numbers over simulate_window.

draws.description: Per-draw results, ordered by draw_date ascending.

v1SimulateResponse.description: SimulateResponse is the response from the Simulate RPC.

draws_with_real_prizes.description:
Number of draws whose prize amounts came from scraped per-draw data
(rather than default estimates or user overrides).

v1SimulateSummary.description: SimulateSummary is the aggregated summary over all simulated draws.

hits.description: Number of combinations that hit this tier in this draw.

total.description: Total prize for this tier in this draw (hits × amount_per_hit).

v1SimulateTierHit.description:
SimulateTierHit records how many combinations hit a specific prize tier
in a single draw.

total_hits.description: Total number of combinations that hit this tier across all draws.

total_amount.description: Total prize amount for this tier across all draws (ILS).

v1SimulateTierSummary.description:
SimulateTierSummary is the aggregated summary for a single prize tier
across all simulated draws.

v1Strength.description: Strength selects whether strong-ball statistics are used.
